title: TestAtlas Command Instruction
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of every .testatlas/commands/*.md file (PRD §11, §38; CMD-02, CMD-04, CMD-05).

command.description: Kebab-case command name; must equal the filename minus '.md'.

capabilities.description: Adapter capabilities this command USES (declare full set; not minimal). The locked capability vocabulary lives in vocabulary.json#/$defs/capability — Plan 09-02 (6 entries: browser, shell, web-fetch, MCP, file-write, subagent-spawn).

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle artifacts updated after every command (PRD §40). Always includes the 5 universal entries (03_execution_status.md, 09_artifact_index.md, 10_command_log.md, 11_workspace_manifest.json, history/run_log.md). Per Quick 260505-wjp (G3+G4): commands MAY also declare command-specific canonical files they write directly (02_test_strategy.md by /atlas:plan; 12_app_map.json by /atlas:explore-codebase) so the doc-drift gate can prove every Lifecycle-declared canonical has either a code-backed writer OR is hand-authored by the owning command.

boundary.description: What this command MUST NOT do (PRD §6.5; mirrors bootstrap §4).
